risks.title: Live-tree apply has not been authorized
risks.stage8_action: AUTHORIZATION_SCOPE.json establishes that live_apply_authorized is false and enumerates the required_later_authorization_fields that must be supplied before execution. The proposal exists but live apply remains blocked. Execution-stage authorization must supply: target_tree, responsible_principal, robert_auth_token_scope, exact_command, rollback_plan, preflight_receipt, dry_run_receipt, final_go_no_go_confirmation.
risks.required_to_close: Later execution-stage prompt with all required_later_authorization_fields and explicit go/no-go confirmation.

risks.title: GitHub Actions CI not independently observed by external connector
risks.stage8_action: Identified as a hard precondition in LIMITED_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL.md: RISK-02 must be resolved before execution-stage is approved. External connector must fetch CI run log for commit 0b63bdc7 and confirm Ran 57 tests / OK.
risks.required_to_close: External connector (non-Claude, non-ChatGPT) fetches and confirms GitHub Actions run log for 0b63bdc7.

risks.title: atomic_swap not rehearsed against real non-CI target
risks.stage8_action: Identified as a soft precondition in LIMITED_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL.md. The limited promotion execution itself will constitute the first supervised rehearsal, provided all hard preconditions are met first. Carry-forward is permitted for the proposal stage.
risks.required_to_close: Supervised rehearsal log produced during execution stage.

risks.title: Protected-surface writes never exercised with real Robert-auth token
risks.stage8_action: TARGET_TREE_SELECTION_CRITERIA.md section 3 requires explicit token scope naming before any protected-class write. If the limited promotion bundle contains no protected-class files (protected_class: false for all entries), RISK-04 does not apply to the execution stage. Must be declared in the execution-stage authorization document.
risks.required_to_close: Execution-stage authorization document declares either: (a) no protected-class files in bundle, or (b) explicit token scope for each protected-class file.

risks.title: External non-Claude/non-ChatGPT reproduction not performed
risks.stage8_action: Identified as a soft precondition in LIMITED_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL.md. Required before production promotion; not required before limited promotion execution. Carry-forward is permitted.
risks.required_to_close: Human developer or third CI system runs bash REPRODUCE.sh from commit 0b63bdc7 and logs result.

risks.title: FM-B atomicity is single-agent scope only
risks.stage8_action: TARGET_TREE_SELECTION_CRITERIA.md section 4 documents FM-B atomicity scope: single-agent installs only; target trees must not be subject to concurrent sidecar writes. No code change required for limited promotion.

risks.title: No re-verify hash check inside atomic_swap before rename
risks.stage8_action: Identified as a soft precondition in LIMITED_PROMOTION_PROPOSAL.md. For limited promotion against a throwaway isolated target (no concurrent writers), TOCTOU risk is negligible. Carry-forward with documented justification: limited promotion target trees must not be subject to concurrent writes (per TARGET_TREE_SELECTION_CRITERIA.md section 1.1), so the window is effectively unexploitable.
risks.required_to_close: Optional: add hash re-verify inside atomic_swap before rename in a future code revision. Not required for limited promotion execution.

summary: RISK-06 is closed by documentation in TARGET_TREE_SELECTION_CRITERIA.md. RISK-01 remains a BLOCKER for live apply — carried forward to execution stage. RISK-02 is a hard precondition for execution-stage approval. RISK-03, RISK-04, RISK-05, RISK-07 are carried forward as nonblocking with defined closure paths.
